arabic text: KAHAAN YEH KARWAAN DAR KARWAAN RAWANA HAI\nKE INKE SATH ME KHUD SAHIBE ZAMANA HAI\nBULA RAHA HAI INHE FATEMA KE DIL KA CHAIN
english translation text: Where is this caravan after caravan travelling?\nThe Master of the Age himself accompanies them.\nThe comfort of Fatima's heart is calling them.

arabic text: SADA E HAYE HUSAINA KI BARHTI JAATI HAI\nYAZID E WAQT KI SAANSE UKHARTI JATI HAI\nQAYAAM E MOWT HAI ZALIM KO YE AZA E HUSSAIN
english translation text: The cry of 'Alas, Hussain' continues to grow;\nthe Yazid of the age struggles for breath.\nFor the tyrant, Hussain's mourning is the uprising of death.

arabic text: NAHIN HAI QASIM O ABBAS AUR ALI AKBAR\nLARAZTE HATH HAI AUR LAASHA E ALI AKBAR\nKHARA HAI DASHT ME TANHA ALI KA NOOR AIN
english translation text: There is no Qasim, Abbas or Ali Akbar;\nhis hands tremble before Ali Akbar's body.\nAli's light of the eyes stands alone in the desert.

arabic text: WOH BHOOK PYAAS WOH GARMI WOH SHIDATE ALAA\nUTHAE LAASH O PE LAASHE AKELA TISHNA KAAM\nUSI HUSSAIN KE GHAM ME BAPA HAI SHORO SHEYN
english translation text: That hunger, thirst, heat and intensity of trial;\nalone and thirsty, he lifted body after body.\nIn that Hussain's grief, cries and lamentation arise.

arabic text: YEH KARBALA KA SAFAR AUR YE ASHIQANE HUSSAIN\nYEH BACHE BURHE JAWAN SAB HAI NASIRAN E HUSSAIN\nKARENGE TAZA YEH PHIR KARZAR E BADRO HUNAIN
english translation text: This journey to Karbala and these lovers of Hussain—\nchildren, elders and youth are all supporters of Hussain.\nThey will renew the battles of Badr and Hunayn.

arabic text: YEH KARBALA HAI KE ISLAM JISSE QAYIM HAI\nMALAIKA PE BHI JISKA TAWAF LAZIM HAI\nZAMEEN PE ARSHE MUALA HAI KARBALA E HUSSAIN
english translation text: This is Karbala, through which Islam remains established;\neven the angels are required to circle it.\nUpon the earth, Karbala of Hussain is the exalted Throne.

arabic text: JANAABE SANIYE ZAHRA PE BHI HO LAAKHO SALAAM\nYAZEED NAAM KIYAA JISNE DAKHIL E DUSHNAM\nAJEEB KAAM KIYA TUNE KHWAHARE HASNAIN
english translation text: Countless salutations upon the second Zahra,\nwho made the name Yazid a word of condemnation.\nWhat an extraordinary deed you accomplished, O sister of Hasan and Hussain.

arabic text: ZAFAR BHALA KOI ISSE BARA ASASA HAI\nKE ZIKR E SHAH E SAHEEHDAN MERA HAWALA HAI\nGHAME HUSSAIN NE BAKSHI HAI MUJHKO ZEB O ZAYN
english translation text: O "Zafar", can there be any treasure greater than this:\nthat the remembrance of the King of Martyrs is my identity?\nThe grief of Hussain has granted me beauty and honour.

arabic text:
WHEN WE WERE ALL MOULDED FROM CLAY, BY HANDS OF OUR
CREATOR
HUSSAIN’S LOVERS WERE BLESSED THAT DAY MOULDED FROM
SOMETHING SWEETER
WE REJOICE WHENEVER WE PRAY, ON THE DUST OF KARBALA
english translation text:
When we were all moulded from
clay by our Creator's hands, Hussain's
lovers were blessed that day, formed
from something sweeter. We rejoice whenever
we pray upon the dust of Karbala.

arabic text:
WHEN FROM DUST OUR LIVES WOULD BEGIN, KARBALA’S DUST WAS
PLACED THERE
STRAIGHT AWAY OUR YEARNING BEGAN, ASKING WHERE IS HIS SHRINE
WHERE
THE FLAME OF LOVE SPRINKLED WITHIN, NEEDING HIS NAME MORE
THAN AIR
english translation text:
When our lives began from dust,
Karbala's soil was placed within us.
At once our yearning began, asking:
where is his shrine? The flame
of love was sprinkled within, needing
his name more than air.

arabic text:
IN THIS NEW WORLD LOST I BECAME HIS SHRINE WAS MY ONLY HOME
HIS SHRINE AND ME ONE AND THE SAME, MY HEARTBEAT CALLS FOR
HIS TOMB
FOR WITH MY BIRTH MY PUPILS CAME, IN THE SHAPE OF HUSSAIN’S
DOME
english translation text:
In this new world I became lost;
his shrine was my only home. His
shrine and I became one, and my
heartbeat calls for his tomb. At birth, even
my pupils came shaped like Hussain's dome.

arabic text:
I SAW LESSONS DRAWN IN HIS SAND, I SAW HUSSAIN EMBRACE HUR
SAYING THEY PLANNED AND ALLAH PLANNED, AND MY LORD
PROMISES MORE
ABIS AGAINST THOUSANDS WOULD STAND, TO DEFEND JUSTICE HE
SWORE
english translation text:
I saw lessons drawn within his
sand; I saw Hussain embrace Hurr,
saying: they planned, and Allah planned,
and my Lord promises more. Abis
stood against thousands, swearing to defend justice.

arabic text: I SAW QASIM SACRIFICE ALL, GIVING HIS FUTURE AWAY\nI SAW WAHAB ANSWER THE CALL, IS THERE ANYONE TO HELP ME\nFAR BE IT YOUR FLAG SHALL FALL, FOR WE HOLD IT HIGH PROUDLY
english translation text: I saw Qasim sacrifice everything, surrendering his future;\nI saw Wahab answer the call: is there anyone to help me?\nFar be it that your flag should fall—we hold it proudly high.

arabic text: MY HEART SWAYS WHEN I WITNESS, THE FLAG OF ABBAS FLUTTER\nWHEN I RECALL HIS SELFLESSNESS, NO CALAMITIES MATTER\nHOLDING HIS FLAG WITH NO ARMS, BEFORE HIS HEAD WOULD SHATTER
english translation text: My heart sways when I behold Abbas's standard flutter.\nWhen I remember his selflessness, no calamity matters:\nhe held the standard without arms before his head was shattered.

arabic text: LIFE CAN ONLY COME TO AN END, WHEN BY HUSSAIN’S TOMB I CRY\nAND IF TO HOME I AM RETURNED, I’LL COME BACK UNTIL I DIE\nTILL MY HANDS TO ABBAS I LEND, HOLDING UP HUSSAIN’S FLAG HIGH
english translation text: Life can only end when I weep beside Hussain's tomb;\nand should I return home, I will come back until I die,\nuntil I lend my hands to Abbas and hold Hussain's standard high.
